key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 35% corporate income tax (impuesto sobre la renta). Ley 2277/2022 raised CIT from 30% to 35% effective tax year 2023. Royalty (8-25% sliding scale based on production volume) is deductible from CIT base. No profit oil mechanism; pure concession with royalty + CIT + Ecopetrol participation.
Sliding scale: 8% for production <5000 bpd; 8-25% graduated up to 600k bpd; gas: 6.4-8%

Ecopetrol optional 20-30% working interest participation via back-in right in E&P contracts. Ecopetrol is 88.5% state-owned (Ministerio de Hacienda). Back-in exercised after commercial discovery; costs carried during exploration then proportionally reimbursed. In practice Ecopetrol participates in majority of commercial fields.
